facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: energy isolation failure on P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4103 and PT-4103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4103 and PT-4103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 4 April 2020 an incident occurred on P-4103 and PT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
